# Additions to Daniel Chapter 1 (Prayer of Azariah & Song of the Three) — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus (Theodotion recension), Additions to Daniel 1 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADD_001_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition 1: Inserted between Daniel 3:23 and 3:24. Part 1 (vv. 1–22): The Prayer of Azariah (Abednego), prayed from within the furnace — a penitential prayer confessing Israel's sin and appealing to God's covenant mercy. Part 2 (vv. 23–68): The Song of the Three Young Men, also called the Benedicite — a cosmic hymn of praise from within the flames, calling all creation to bless the Lord.]*

---

### Part 1: The Prayer of Azariah (vv. 1–22)

**1:1** And they-walked in the-midst of the-fire singing-hymns to God and blessing the-Lord.

**1:2** And Azariah stood and prayed thus; and having-opened his mouth in-the midst of the-fire he-said:

**1:3** "Blessed are you, O Lord God of our-fathers, and to-be-praised and to-be-exalted-above-all forever;

**1:4** and blessed is your holy and glorious name, and to-be-hyper-praised and to-be-exalted-above-all forever.

**1:5** Blessed are you in the-holy temple of your glory, and to-be-hyper-praised and to-be-exalted-above-all forever.

**1:6** Blessed are you upon the-throne of your kingdom, and to-be-hyper-praised and to-be-exalted-above-all forever.

**1:7** Blessed are you, the-one-who-looks-upon the-depths and sits upon the-cherubim, and to-be-praised and to-be-exalted-above-all forever.

**1:8** Blessed are you in the-firmament of-the heaven, and to-be-hyper-praised and glorified forever.

**1:9** Bless the-Lord, all the-works of-the Lord; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:10** Bless the-Lord, you-angels of-the Lord; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:11** Bless the-Lord, you-heavens; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:12** Bless the-Lord, all you-waters above the-heavens; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:13** Bless the-Lord, all you-hosts of-the Lord; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:14** Bless the-Lord, sun and moon; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:15** Bless the-Lord, stars of-heaven; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:16** Bless the-Lord, every rain and dew; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:17** Bless the-Lord, all you-winds; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:18** Bless the-Lord, fire and heat; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:19** Bless the-Lord, winter-cold and summer; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:20** Bless the-Lord, dews and hoar-frosts; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:21** Bless the-Lord, frost and cold; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:22** Bless the-Lord, ice and snow; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:23** Bless the-Lord, nights and days; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:24** Bless the-Lord, light and darkness; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:25** Bless the-Lord, lightning and clouds; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:26** Let the-earth bless the-Lord; let it-sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:27** Bless the-Lord, mountains and hills; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:28** Bless the-Lord, everything sprouting on the-earth; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:29** Bless the-Lord, seas and rivers; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:30** Bless the-Lord, springs; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:31** Bless the-Lord, you-whales and all things-that-move in-the waters; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:32** Bless the-Lord, all you-birds of-the heaven; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:33** Bless the-Lord, all you-wild-beasts and cattle; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:34** Bless the-Lord, you-sons of men; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:35** Bless the-Lord, O Israel; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:36** Bless the-Lord, you-priests of-the Lord; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:37** Bless the-Lord, you-servants of-the Lord; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:38** Bless the-Lord, spirits and souls of-the righteous; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:39** Bless the-Lord, you-holy and humble-of-heart; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever.

**1:40** Bless the-Lord, Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael; sing-hymns and exalt him above-all forever. For he-rescued us from Hades and saved us from the-hand of-death, and delivered us from-the midst of the-burning fiery furnace; even from-the midst of the-fire he-delivered us.

**1:41** Give-thanks to the-Lord, because he-is good, for his covenant-love is forever.

**1:42** Bless all who-fear the-Lord, the-God of gods; sing-hymns and give-thanks to him, because his covenant-love is forever."

---

*[The Prayer of Azariah, inserted at the beginning of this addition, follows:]*

**Note on structure:** The foregoing (vv. 1–8, then vv. 9–42) follows the Theodotion arrangement. The Azariah prayer properly (vv. 3–22 in the Greek Prayer of Azariah section) runs as follows in the source:

**[Prayer of Azariah, vv. 1–22 of the prayer proper:]**

**Pr.Az.1** Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our-fathers, praised and to-be-exalted above-all forever.

**Pr.Az.2** And righteous is your judgment in-all things that you-have-done to us, and all your works are true and your ways straight, and all your judgments are truth.

**Pr.Az.3** And true judgments you-have-carried-out in-all things that you-have-brought upon us and upon Jerusalem, the-holy city of our-fathers, because in truth and judgment you-brought these-things upon us because-of our sins.

**Pr.Az.4** For we-sinned and acted-lawlessly in departing from you.

**Pr.Az.5** And in all things we-sinned and did-not-listen to your commandments;

**Pr.Az.6** we-did-not-keep them and we-did-not-do as you-commanded us that it-might-go-well for us.

**Pr.Az.7** And all that you-brought upon us and all that you-did to us, you-did in true judgment.

**Pr.Az.8** And you-gave us into the-hands of lawless enemies, hateful rebels, and to an unjust king, the-most-evil in all the-earth.

**Pr.Az.9** And now we-are-not-able to-open our mouth; shame and reproach have-come to be upon your servants and upon those-worshiping you.

**Pr.Az.10** Do-not deliver us up forever, for the-sake of your name, and do-not dissolve your covenant,

**Pr.Az.11** and do-not draw-away your mercy from us, for the-sake of Abraham your beloved, and Isaac your servant, and Israel your holy-one,

**Pr.Az.12** to whom you-spoke to-make-numerous their seed as the-stars of-heaven and as the-sand on the-shore of the-sea.

**Pr.Az.13** For, Lord, we-have-become fewer than all the-nations and are-humbled this day in all the-earth because-of our sins.

**Pr.Az.14** And there-is at this time no prince or prophet or leader, no burnt-offering or sacrifice or oblation or incense, no place to-offer first-fruits before you and to-find mercy.

**Pr.Az.15** But with a broken soul and a spirit of-humility, may-we-be-accepted.

**Pr.Az.16** As a burnt-offering of rams and bulls and as ten-thousands of fat lambs, so let our sacrifice be before you today, and may it-accomplish the-things before you fully; because there-is no shame for those-who-trust in you.

**Pr.Az.17** And now we-follow you with our whole heart and we-fear you and we-seek your face.

**Pr.Az.18** Do-not put-us-to-shame, but deal with us according to your gentleness and according to your abundant mercy.

**Pr.Az.19** And deliver us according to your marvelous works, and give glory to your name, O Lord.

**Pr.Az.20** And let all those-who-do evil to your servants be-shamed, and let them-be dishonored and stripped of all their power, and let their strength be-crushed.

**Pr.Az.21** Let them-know that you alone are the-Lord God, glorious over all the-earth."

**Pr.Az.22** And the-servants of-the king who-threw them in did-not-stop making the-furnace hot with naphtha, pitch, tow, and brushwood,

**Pr.Az.23** and the-flame poured out above the-furnace forty-nine cubits,

**Pr.Az.24** and it-spread out and burned those-of-the Chaldeans whom it-found around the-furnace.

**Pr.Az.25** But the-angel of-the Lord came-down into the-furnace to be with Azariah and his companions, and he-drove-out the-fiery flame from the-furnace,

**Pr.Az.26** and made the-inside of-the furnace as though a moist wind-of-whistling were blowing through, and the-fire did-not-touch them at all and did-not cause-pain and did-not-trouble them.
